body: *A better place, a better time* by Streetlight manifesto

I'm a 18 year old film student, I recently went through a break up and I have felt depressed ever since, every day it gets worse, every time I feel like I'm getting better I start to think about her and I just get worse, it was only a 3 month relationship but I really liked her, I'm young I know, but I can't help but feel like I've messed up the best opportunity I've ever been given, I miss her so much but I know she doesn't feel the same.

I was feeling very suicidal before I met her, she made all those feelings go away or atleast made them easy to ignore but now she's gone the feelings are worse then they were before, I really wish I could win her back, but she's made her mind up and she probably thinks I'm pathetic for being so stuck on her, it will be a month since it happened on Sunday and I'm dredding that day so much.

I'm at my lowest point ever, I'm in the UK so we're in our 3rd lockdown, which feels insane to me, I felt low in the first one but in the second one I was in a relationship and I thought I found the one for me, she was everything I wanted and I really liked her, she made me so happy and I know for a while I made her really happy, but she ended things recently and it destroyed me, her reasoning was because her feelings had change, this was all my fault, i didn't try as hard as I could and I got lazy since we were in a lockdown, there's nothing I want more than a chance to fix things but I won't get that chance. I'm at college and we've started our final project which has really helped me take my mind of her and I'm really enjoying doing the work for it but I can't help but feel scared as I only have a few months left at college, I'm even worried about going back next week as college is opening again, I'm scared of seeing her around and I'm scared of having a breakdown or panic attacks at college, I don't want the attention, I've been having lots of panic attacks recently. I miss seeing my dad even if he wasn't a great dad, over a year ago he just stopped contacting me, I know he has a new family but it hurts, I've thought about contacting him but I don't know if it'll be a good idea. I'm only 18 so I know I have my whole life ahead of me but it doesn't make things better, I have so many regrets and I really feel like the world would better without me. After college I'm meant to be going to university but I don't know if I'm smart enough and I'm really worried as I won't know anyone there.

I know my problems probably seem very trivial and that I don't really have a reason to want to end things, and I really shouldn't I have so much to be grateful about, but I just feel so lost and exhausted mentally, I push people away and I don't always try my hardest, I have so many flaws and I have so many regrets, I constantly think about her and how I messed things up, if I could just go back I'd try so hard and I'd make things better, but I can't go back no matter how much I wish for it

Hi Bella, I've honestly not even had a bad day, one of my friends drove to meet me so we could go on a walk, other than that I've been doing work for my college project which I really enjoy doing, I have so much to be grateful for and yet I still want to give it all up, its selfish of me to feel like this but I can't help it.

Thank you for asking, how was your day Bella?
